subject: Quick note on Emmet J Kelly and Co's website
bodyText:
Hi,

I'm Mani from Rogue.

We look for solid businesses that still look stuck online - and Emmet J Kelly and Co stood out.

Banbridge solicitors on Bridge Street - and emmetjkelly.com still pulls html5.js from html5shiv.googlecode.com/svn/trunk, a Google Code polyfill Microsoft-era browsers needed years ago. Established County Down practice; a front end still depending on a long-retired repo.

If useful, I'll send a short 3-point teardown over email - what's dated, what's costing you, and the first fix. No call required.

Reply YES and I'll send it.
